name: smart-skill-matrix
description: A comprehensive skill management and objective tracking system

scripts.install: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix mails
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:email"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:email"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:email
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:email
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:frontend -- --coverage && npm run test:backend -- --coverage && npm run test:email -- --coverage
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:email
scripts.clean: npm run clean:frontend && npm run clean:backend && npm run clean:email
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:env && npm run setup:database
scripts.setup:database: psql -d smart_skill_matrix -f database/migration.sql && psql -d smart_skill_matrix -f database/seed.sql

author: Smart Skill Matrix Team
